# Bundled frontend libraries

These files are vendored for offline operation and are not application source
code. Their upstream licenses are preserved in the distributed files where
available.

- `uplot.min.js` / `uplot.min.css`: uPlot, MIT License, Copyright Leeoniya.
  Upstream: https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot
- `mermaid-11.16.1.min.js`: Mermaid, MIT License, Copyright Mermaid authors.
  The bundle also contains third-party notices in its header/comments.
  Upstream: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid

When upgrading either library, update this notice and inspect the upstream
release license/notice files before committing the new bundle.
